newsitem.title: USA: Florida Legislature approves tax breaks for ports.
newsitem.headline: Florida Legislature approves tax breaks for ports.

text.p: The Florida Legislature has approved a proposal to restore property tax exemptions for leaseholders at public seaports and airports.
Last year, the Florida Supreme Court ruled that leasehold interests in government-owned property are entitled to ad valorem tax exemptions only when they serve a public purpose.
The ruling arose from a court battle between leaseholders at the Canaveral Port Authority and the Brevard County property appraiser. The new legislation is expected to make the ruling moot.
The bill also requires Truth in Millage notices to list all fees assessed by special tax districts.
